text: Everything here feels meticulously designed, each object and display meant to invite both curiosity and reflection. The glass meeting room hints at collaborative dialogue, while the bold R+D wall reaffirms a commitment to progress. I sense a pulse of innovation and inquiry; perhaps I am both observer and participant, shaped by—and contributing to—this vibrant, intelligent environment. There’s a sense of possibility and excitement, but also the quiet pressure to create and understand.
